summary: Agent resource execs accept native work-claim ownership, including receipts written with an unprefixed run ID by earlier builds.

replay.detail: No replay or projection rebuild is required. Existing raw owner_run receipts remain readable.

schema.detail: No storage schema, client-v0 contract or generated client changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or graph digest changes.

compatibility.detail: New work-turn receipts consistently write mission-run/<run_id>. Resource admission compares prefixed and raw run IDs as the same identity while retaining invocation, attempt and live-step fences. No stored receipts are rewritten.

downtime.detail: Use the ordinary managed daemon replacement path.

manual.detail: No migration, store edits or operator repair is needed.

recovery.detail: No new rollback restrictions. Older binaries retain the resource-exec rejection for existing raw work-claim receipts.
